page.layout: One printed page, blank apart from show-through of the title page from the reverse side and a library stamp.
page.notes: The page is blank. The faint, mirrored lettering in the upper half (the title "SYSTEMA SYSTEMATVM", with lines such as "CLARISSIMI VIRI", "IN THEOLOGIA" and "DRVSIVS TOBIAS") and the faint mirrored lines near the bottom are show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. The blue oval-free rectangular stamp of the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München in the centre is a library stamp and is left out. A few brown spots and stains are visible, and the scan edges are dark.
